items.title: Double Seals
items.description: Adds new Double versions of the 4 base game seals as well as all my other seal mods. by @jacobr1227

items.title: Orange Seals
items.description: Adds new Orange seal When discarded, enhances a random card. by @jacobr1227

items.title: Silver Seals
items.description: Adds new Silver seal When held in hand at end of round, creates 1 spectral card. by @jacobr1227

items.title: Talisman
items.description: discord - Talisman is a mod for Balatro that increases the score cap from ~10^308 to ~10^10^308, allowing for endless runs to go past "naneinf" and Ante 39. by @MathIsFun_

items.title: Brainstorm
items.description: discord - Brainstorm allows for super-fast rerolling through the use of an in-game key bind. by @OceanRamen

items.title: typist
items.description: typist is an implementation of fully keyboard-driven UX for Balatro and includes a lot of QoL shortcuts as well. by @kasimeka

items.title: Advanced Screen Shake
items.description: Advanced Screen Shake is a mod that allows you to set the level of your screenshake unreasonably high. by @DeveloperRowan

items.title: Green Needle
items.description: Green Needle is a powerful seed search mod inspired by Brainstorm, with multi-platform native search engine. by @lafiosca

items.title: Alternative Speed Toggle
items.description: Adds a draggable HUD checkbox and rebindable shortcut to force an alternative game speed while playing a blind. by @PixeledLobster

items.title: Quick Hand Selector
items.description: Adds an in-run panel with buttons to select any available poker hand, suit or combination in one click, with rebindable keyboard shortcuts for every action. by @PixeledLobster

items.title: JokerDisplay
items.description: Adds a small window under vanilla Jokers that displays useful information. by @nh6574

items.title: Malverk
items.description: Malverk is an all-in-one texture manager. With an inbuilt API for AltTextures and TexturePacks, Malverk integrates a simple UI to customise which textures are applied to your game whenever you wish. by @Eremel_

items.title: Readabletro
items.description: Readabletro improves readability of the game, especially on lower res screens (Steam Deck) by using a more legible vector typeface and smoothly upscaled card textures. by @bladeSk

items.title: Planet Card Cash-Out Mod
items.description: discord - "Use" a planet card while the cash-out animations play. by @antler5

items.title: Cartomancer
items.description: Improved deck view and joker management with stacking and scrolling, capped deck pile and scoring flames customization. Made for long endless runs and crazy modded runs. by @stupxd

items.title: Blueprint
items.description: Dynamically adjust Blueprint joker texture to the joker it is copying. by @stupxd

items.title: #1 Victory Royale!
items.description: On win screen, replaces the "YOU WIN!" text with "#1 VICTORY ROYALE!" and the default win music with fortnite default dance. by @Muddie

items.title: Solatro
items.description: Turns the entire game into a game of Solitaire. by @bryanthaboi

items.title: When the impostor is Sun
items.description: Renames The Sun tarot card to The Sus and replaces its texture. by @Muddie

items.title: DebugPlus
items.description: discord - A simple mod that adds a bunch more debug functions on top of Balatro's built in. by @WilsontheWolf

items.title: ScoreImprovements
items.description: discord - Misc score improvements (Better score display, fixed fire at inf, inf blinds let you win). by @WilsontheWolf
